component.name: Ask the Model
component.summary: Chat with locally managed AI models

description.p: Ask the Model is a local-first desktop chat interface for locally managed language models through an Ollama-compatible provider. The current release discovers compatible provider-managed models, streams responses and keeps conversation context in memory for the current session.

The project is being developed toward natural-language exploration of scientific dynamical-model repositories such as Empirical World3 Dynamics, Cognitive Belief Dynamics and Romanian Monetary Dynamics. Repository-aware retrieval and scientific provenance are not yet implemented, and the source repositories remain authoritative for their own scientific content.
Installation and release-distribution correction with a directly downloadable Flatpak release asset and clarified dependency guidance.
Local Chat Baseline with local Ollama discovery, completion-capable AI-model selection, refresh progress, streamed chat and in-session history.
